final: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), mu AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM r) SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - mu.mean_rate AS diff_from_mean FROM r, mu WHERE r.rate > mu.mean_rate
